# Terms and Conditions

Welcome to MintrAIQ.

By creating an account or using the Platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree to these Terms, you must not use the Platform.

1. The Most Important Thing: No Financial Advice
1.1 Information, Not Advice: MintrAIQ is a technology platform designed to aggregate data and provide automated, algorithmic insights. MintrAIQ is not a Financial Advice Provider (FAP) and is not registered under the New Zealand Financial Markets Conduct Act 2013. 1.2 No Fiduciary Relationship: Nothing generated by the Platform—including but not limited to AI insights, spending categorization, budget pacing, "Safe to Spend" metrics, or "Discipline" nudges—constitutes personalized financial, investment, tax, or legal advice.

1.3 User Responsibility: You are solely responsible for your financial decisions. You should consult with a certified financial advisor or accountant before making significant financial decisions based on data surfaced by MintrAIQ.

2. Artificial Intelligence & Data Disclaimers

While we strive for accuracy, AI is subject to errors, miscategorizations, and "hallucinations." You must independently verify any AI-generated insight before acting upon it.

2.2 Read-Only Data: MintrAIQ operates on a strict "read-only" basis. We work from the bank statements and receipts you choose to upload. MintrAIQ cannot initiate payments, transfer funds, modify your bank account, or otherwise transact on your behalf.

2.3 Data Accuracy: Our analysis is only as accurate as the statements and receipts you provide. We accept no liability for discrepancies caused by incomplete or out-of-date statements, incorrect categorization, or OCR (Optical Character Recognition) errors during receipt scanning.

3. Account Security & Subscriptions

3.2 Billing and Subscriptions: Certain features of MintrAIQ are available on a premium subscription basis. Fees are billed in advance on a recurring cycle. You may cancel at any time, but we do not provide refunds for partial billing periods unless required by the Consumer Guarantees Act 1993.

Our total liability for any claims under these Terms shall not exceed the amount you paid to MintrAIQ for the use of the Platform in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.

privacy_policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_policy.content:
# Privacy Policy
**Last Updated:** 21 August 2026

Welcome to MintrAIQ. We are committed to protecting your personal information and your right to privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website or use our mobile application (collectively, the "Platform").

1. Information We Collect
We collect personal information that you voluntarily provide to us when registering for the Platform, expressing an interest in obtaining information about us or our products, or otherwise interacting with the Platform.

Identity & Contact Data: Name, email address, date of birth, and phone number provided during the account bootstrap process.

Financial Data: Transaction history, balances and receipt data, taken from the bank statements and receipts you choose to upload. MintrAIQ is read-only by design: it cannot initiate payments, transfer funds, or transact on your behalf, and it does not ask for or store your bank login credentials.

Device & Usage Data: Push notification tokens, mobile device IDs, IP addresses, operating system details, and interaction data (such as which features you use and your onboarding state) to optimize your app experience.

AI Interaction Data: The prompts, categories, and goals you provide to the MintrAIQ assistant.

2. How We Use Your Information
We process your information for purposes based on legitimate business interests, the fulfillment of our contract with you, and compliance with our legal obligations:

To provide the core service: Aggregating your financial data, generating budgets, and providing AI-driven insights and pacing nudges.

To manage your account: Handling authentication, session management, and syncing your onboarding state across devices.

To communicate with you: Sending push notifications regarding account alerts, weekly summaries, and system updates based on your notification preferences.

To improve categorisation: When you correct how a transaction has been categorised, we keep that correction to improve the accuracy of our own categorisation model. We keep only a normalised form of the transaction description with the category you chose. The description is stripped of card numbers, reference numbers and other identifying details, and your user ID is not stored with it, so these records are not linked back to you. We do not sell this information, and we do not use it to train third-party or general-purpose AI models.

3. How We Share Your Information
We only share information with third parties that perform services for us or on our behalf, requiring them to protect your data. We do not sell your personal data.

AI Service Providers: We use third-party AI services operated by Google (Gemini) and Groq to categorise transactions, read receipts, identify bills in a connected mailbox, and answer the questions you ask Mintor. What we send them is limited to transaction descriptions and amounts, receipt images and the text extracted from them, the content of your questions, and — only if you have connected an email account — the subject and body text of the messages our automated filter has already singled out as likely bills. Section 4 explains that filter and exactly what reaches Google. We do not send the name and email address on your account, or your bank login credentials. One limit worth knowing: transaction descriptions are sent exactly as your bank wrote them, so a description may itself contain a name or a reference number. These providers act as our processors under contract, are required to protect your information to the same standard set out in this policy, and are contractually prohibited from using it to train their public models. Data is transmitted over encrypted connections.

Authentication & Hosting Providers: To securely manage your identity tokens and host our encrypted databases.

4. Connected Email Accounts
Where you choose to connect an email account, MintrAIQ accesses that mailbox on a strictly read-only basis to detect bills, subscriptions, receipts and bank statement emails, and to surface upcoming payments in the app. We never send, modify or delete email, and we never mark messages as read. Connection tokens and any credentials are encrypted at rest, and you can disconnect a mailbox at any time from Settings, which revokes our access.

Which mailboxes can be connected: Outlook or Hotmail, and other mailboxes via IMAP. If we add support for another provider, we will update this policy before it is switched on.

How we identify bills: detection runs in two stages, and the first uses no AI at all. An automated filter reads each message looking for bill-like wording together with a dollar amount. The great majority of your mail fails that test, is discarded immediately, and never leaves our systems.

Only a message that passes the filter goes to the second stage. There we send its subject line and up to the first 6,000 characters of its body to Google's Gemini API, which confirms whether it really is a bill and picks out the merchant, the amount, the due date and how often it recurs. Much of what this stage does is reject marketing emails that the first filter mistook for bills, so it discards more than it keeps. The body is used for that check and is not stored. Google processes this content as our processor, is required to protect it to the same standard set out in this policy, and is contractually prohibited from using it to train its public models.

What we keep from your mailbox: for each message that looks like a bill, receipt or subscription, we store the merchant, the amount, the due or paid date, how often it appears to recur, and the subject line of that message. If you switch on bank statement scanning, PDF statements attached to matching emails are imported and the transactions in them are stored alongside statements you upload yourself. We also keep a record of which messages we have already checked, so the same message is not scanned twice. We do not store the body of your emails and we do not copy your mailbox.

5. Data Security & Storage
We implement industry-standard technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information. Your data is encrypted in transit using TLS/SSL and at rest within our databases. While we do our best to protect your personal information, transmission of personal information to and from our Platform is at your own risk. You should only access the Platform within a secure environment.

6. Data Retention & Account Deletion
We keep your information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Policy unless otherwise required by law.

Your Right to Delete:
You have the right to request the complete deletion of your account and associated data. You can initiate an automated account deletion directly within the MintrAIQ mobile app by navigating to Settings > Account > Delete Account. Upon request, we will permanently delete or anonymize your identity, financial data, and push notification tokens from our active databases, subject to any legal obligations to retain specific transaction records for compliance purposes.

7. Your Rights under the New Zealand Privacy Act 2020
If you are a resident of New Zealand, you have specific rights regarding your personal information:

Access: You have the right to ask for a copy of any personal information we hold about you.

Correction: You have the right to ask for it to be corrected if you think it is wrong.

8. Changes to this Privacy Policy
We may update this privacy notice from time to time. The updated version will be indicated by an updated "Last Updated" date and the updated version will be effective as soon as it is accessible. We encourage you to review this privacy notice frequently to be informed of how we are protecting your information.

9. Contact Us
If you have questions, comments, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or your data, please contact us at:
Email: ram@mintraiq.com
Address: MintrAIQ, Auckland.

support.title: Support
support.content:
# Support
Need help with MintrAIQ? Email us and a real person will reply.

**Email:** ram@mintraiq.com

We aim to respond within 2 business days (New Zealand time). To help us sort things out quickly, tell us the email address on your account, the screen you were on, and what you expected to happen.

## Managing your subscription
Subscriptions bought in the iOS app are billed by Apple, not by us. To view, change or cancel one, open the Settings app on your iPhone, tap your name, tap Subscriptions, then select MintrAIQ. Cancelling stops future renewals and you keep access until the end of the period you have already paid for.

Refunds for App Store purchases are handled by Apple at reportaproblem.apple.com. If the problem is on our side, email us and we will help.

## Deleting your account
You can delete your account and its data at any time from Settings > Account > Delete Account in the mobile app, or at mintraiq.com/delete-account. This permanently deletes or anonymises your identity, financial data and notification tokens, subject to any records we are legally required to keep.

## Common questions
**How does MintrAIQ see my bank transactions?**
We connect through a licensed third-party provider on a strictly read-only basis. We never see or store your online banking password, and MintrAIQ cannot move, transfer or alter money in your accounts.

**Which banks are supported?**
ASB, ANZ, BNZ, Westpac and Kiwibank. You can also add data by uploading statements or scanning receipts if you would rather not connect an account.

**A transaction is in the wrong category. Can I fix it?**
Yes. Recategorise it in the app and MintrAIQ will learn from the correction.

**Are the forecasts and insights financial advice?**
No. MintrAIQ is a technology platform, not a registered Financial Advice Provider under the New Zealand Financial Markets Conduct Act. Everything the app produces, including forecasts, budgets and AI-generated insights, is informational only, is generated from your own data, and can contain errors. Please check anything before acting on it, and talk to a qualified adviser about significant financial decisions.

**How do I get a copy of, or correct, the information you hold about me?**
Under the New Zealand Privacy Act 2020 you can ask for a copy of the personal information we hold about you, and ask us to correct it. Email ram@mintraiq.com and we will action your request.

## Privacy and terms
Our full Privacy Policy and Terms and Conditions are linked at the top of this page.
